summary: KEPCO filed a Form 6-K announcing a shareholders' registry closure from November 17 to November 25, 2026, to fix the record date for voting at an upcoming extraordinary general meeting. Shareholders registered as of November 16, 2026 will be entitled to vote. No meeting agenda, resolutions, transaction terms, or board recommendations are disclosed. This is a routine non-US meeting/record-date notice, the equivalent of a US record-date or meeting notice filing, with no special-situations mechanics, pricing, or deal clock; nothing to arbitrage.
